data.title: Mint Announces Nasdaq Share Tokenization Initiative on Ethereum and Solana
data.description: The binding agreement with CURRENC Capital will support the issuer-sponsored tokenization of a portion of Mint Incorporation Limited’s (NASDAQ:MIMI) existing Class A ordinary shares, although completion remains subject to regulatory requirements. Key Investor TakeawaysMint Incorporation Limited (NASDAQ:MIMI) has entered a binding consulting agreement with CURRENC Capital to pursue Nasdaq share tokenization on Ethereum and Solana.
